Our Philosophy

We didn't start a brand.
We started a correction.

Walk into any shop in Nagpur and pick up a packet of milk. It has almost certainly been homogenised, extended with milk solids, and processed so heavily that most of what nature put in has been removed. Families, pregnant mothers, and newborns are consuming this daily — and calling it healthy.

"Our purpose is to make products that build and maintain health. Not just food — functional nutrition. Dairy consumed the way our ancestors consumed it: rich, honest, and alive."

Parikrushnam was founded in Nagpur in 2021 because we could not find honest dairy for our own families. So we went to the source — indigenous cow farms and premium buffalo farms right here in Nagpur district — and built a system where transparency is not a marketing claim. It is the entire model.

🌱
Food Integrity

What we sell is exactly what it says it is. No milk solids added to bulk it up. No artificial flavoring to mask quality. The ingredient list is short because nature already did the work.

🔬
Science-Backed Nutrition

Minimal processing is not a philosophy — it is a nutritional choice. Every step we avoid (homogenisation, over-pasteurisation, additives) is a nutrient we preserve for your family.

🐄
Ethical Sourcing

Happy cattle on a balanced diet produce better milk. This is proven by both science and tradition. The quality in your glass begins with the quality of life at our farms.

📍
Deep Local Roots

We operate exclusively in Nagpur. Not because we lack ambition — because serving one city with absolute excellence means more to us than diluted reach across many.

Know Your Dairy

From the farm
to your door —
every single step.

Most dairy brands don't show you this. We do. Full transparency in procurement, chilling, testing, and delivery — because a brand that can't trace its product from animal to your table shouldn't be selling food.

🐄
Step 01

Farm & Animal Selection

We source exclusively from Nagpur-district farms running indigenous Gir, Sahiwal cows and Zafrabadi, Murrah buffalo. Every farm is evaluated for animal welfare, feeding practices, and hygiene before we partner.

Verified Farms Only
🤲
Step 02

Ethical Milking

Calves feed first — always. We collect only the natural surplus in clean, stainless-steel vessels. No stress-inducing procedures. No hormones to increase yield. The animal's wellbeing is non-negotiable.

No Synthetic Hormones
❄️
Step 03

Chilled Within 30 Minutes

Milk begins degrading the moment it leaves the animal. We chill to below 4°C within 30 minutes of collection. This controls bacterial growth naturally — without relying on heavy processing to compensate for poor handling.

Cold Chain Integrity
🔬
Step 04

Testing & Standards

Every batch is tested before leaving the farm. We maintain the lowest bacterial count in our category — not through additives, but through hygiene discipline at every stage of the process.

Lowest Bacterial Count
🌿
Step 05

Minimal Processing

We process only as much as safety demands. Low-temperature gentle handling preserves the natural fat structure, enzymes, beneficial bacteria, and fat-soluble vitamins that your body actually uses.

High Bioavailability
🚫
Step 06

No Additives. Full Stop.

No milk solids. No artificial flavoring. No stabilisers. No preservatives. No homogenisation. What the animal gave is what you receive — nothing added, nothing stripped beyond what safety requires.

Pure Composition
📍
Step 07

Batch Traceability

Every product batch is traceable to its source farm and collection date. If you want to know which farm your ghee came from, we'll tell you. That level of transparency is intentional.

Farm to Table Traced
🚚
Step 08

Same-Day Delivery

Products are prepared and dispatched on the same morning, cold-chain maintained throughout. Delivered to Nagpur homes while they're at their freshest. Not refrigerated warehouse stock — genuinely fresh.

Freshness Guaranteed

Bilona Ghee

🛒 Order Now

Made by the traditional Bilona method — A2 milk is curd-set overnight, hand-churned into white butter, then slow-simmered over a gentle flame until golden and granular. Aromatic, rich in fat-soluble vitamins A, D, E and K2. Not comparable to commercial ghee produced in industrial centrifuges in three hours.

Cattle & Farming

The quality begins
long before
the product.

The nutritional quality of dairy is directly determined by how the animal lives. A stressed cow on poor feed produces milk that reflects that. Our animals live on balanced diets, in open environments, with the care that both Vedic tradition and modern animal science prescribe.

We work with both own and partner farms within Nagpur district — each evaluated for welfare standards, feeding practices, and hygiene systems before we source from them.

`n`n
Indigenous Cow
`n
Gir
Gujarat Origin

One of India's oldest and most revered indigenous breeds. Produces pure A2 beta-casein milk. Known for high fat content and deep nutritional profile.

`n`n
Indigenous Cow
`n
Sahiwal
Punjab Origin

Among the highest milk-yielding indigenous breeds. Exceptional heat tolerance and disease resistance. A2 milk with rich nutritional composition.

`n`n
Premium Buffalo
`n
Zafrabadi
Gujarat Origin

One of India's largest buffalo breeds. Produces milk exceptionally high in fat — ideal for rich dairy products with superior nutritional density.

`n`n
Premium Buffalo
`n
Murrah
Haryana Origin · Black Gold

The world's highest milk-yielding buffalo breed. Called "Black Gold" for its premium milk quality. Superior fat and protein profile in every batch.

Milk from our Zafrabadi & Murrah buffalo becomes our Raw A2 Buffalo Milk — 100% raw, tested daily, zero additives.

🌿
Balanced Natural Diet

Seasonal grasses, green fodder, and carefully formulated feed supplements. No low-cost filler feed. What the animal eats directly determines what ends up in the milk — and we take that seriously.

☀️
Open Environment

No confined stalls. Animals move freely across open farm areas. Physical activity and low-stress environments are proven to influence milk composition positively.

🐄
Calf-First Milking

The calf feeds first, always. We collect only the natural surplus after the calf is satisfied. This traditional practice ensures the animal is not over-milked and the calf receives its complete nutrition.

💉
No Growth Hormones

Zero synthetic hormones to artificially boost yield. Our volumes are smaller because our animals are not stressed into producing more than is natural. That restraint shows in the quality.

🛡️
Breed Preservation

Every purchase supports indigenous Indian cattle breeds that commercial dairy nearly wiped out in a single generation. Gir and Sahiwal populations declined sharply after HF/Jersey crossbreeding was incentivised. We are part of bringing them back.

🔍
Open Farm Policy

Our farms are not a trade secret. Visit us. Watch the milking. Meet the animals. We believe radical transparency about sourcing is not just ethical — it is the strongest brand statement we can make.

Dairy Science

A1 vs A2 Beta-Casein: What the Science Actually Says

Most milk in India contains A1 beta-casein from cross-bred cows. A2, found in indigenous breeds, behaves differently in digestion — and the research is increasingly clear on why this matters.

Our detailed article on this topic is currently being updated. If you have specific questions, our experts are always available to help clarify the science and facts around dairy consumption.

Processing

What Homogenisation Does to Your Milk — and Why We Don't Do It

Homogenisation makes milk look uniform and last longer. It also alters fat molecule size in ways that may affect how your gut absorbs it. Understanding this changes how you read a label.

Our detailed article on this topic is currently being updated. If you have specific questions, our experts are always available to help clarify the science and facts around dairy consumption.

Contact Us
Gut Health

Live Cultures, Probiotics, and Why Your Dahi Should Be Alive

Commercial dahi is often heat-treated after setting, killing the live cultures. Real probiotic benefit requires those cultures to be alive when consumed. Here is how to tell the difference.

Our detailed article on this topic is currently being updated. If you have specific questions, our experts are always available to help clarify the science and facts around dairy consumption.

Children's Nutrition

Dairy for Children: Protein Quality Over Protein Quantity

A child consuming high-quality dairy absorbs and uses more protein per gram than one consuming processed alternatives. Bioavailability — not just label numbers — is what drives growth.

Our detailed article on this topic is currently being updated. If you have specific questions, our experts are always available to help clarify the science and facts around dairy consumption.

Contact Us
Maternal Nutrition

Pregnancy, Ghee, and the Fat-Soluble Vitamins Your Body Needs

Vitamins A, D, E, and K2 are fat-soluble — they require dietary fat to be absorbed. Traditional Indian use of ghee during pregnancy is not superstition. It has a nutritional basis that modern research is now confirming.

Our detailed article on this topic is currently being updated. If you have specific questions, our experts are always available to help clarify the science and facts around dairy consumption.

Contact Us
Food Integrity

Dairy Adulteration in India: What FSSAI Studies Have Found

Detergent, urea, starch, and synthetic milk have all been found in commercial dairy samples across India. Understanding how adulteration happens and how to avoid it starts with understanding the supply chain.

Pregnancy Nutrition

Fat-soluble vitamins (A, D, K2) in our Bilona ghee and dahi are critical during pregnancy. Several Nagpur families have made us their trusted dairy partner through pregnancy on doctor's guidance.

👶
Newborn & Infant Health

Families have reported choosing Parikrushnam for introducing dairy to their newborns — valuing the absence of additives, the probiotic content, and the nutritional density over commercial alternatives.

🧒
Child Growth & Development

High-bioavailability protein, natural calcium, and live probiotic cultures support bone development, immune function, and gut health in children. Quality over quantity — always.

🧘
Lactose Sensitivity

A2 milk still contains lactose, so it isn't a fix for true lactose intolerance. But some people who feel discomfort after regular milk find A2 milk and live-culture dairy easier on digestion, since research suggests A1 beta-casein — not lactose alone — may be behind some of that discomfort. If you're sensitive, we'd suggest trying a small amount first.

💪
Daily Adult Wellness

For adults seeking functional nutrition — clean protein, healthy fats, natural calcium, and probiotic support — our full range provides a daily nutritional foundation without compromise.

Transparency Centre

We have nothing
to hide.
Here is everything.

Transparency is not a section on our website. It is the foundation of everything we do. The standards below are not aspirational — they describe what we do every single day. Ask us to verify any of them.

Ask us anything →
🌱
No Milk Solids — Ever

We never add milk solids to bulk up our products. Every gram you pay for is genuine dairy from our animals — nothing else.

🎨
No Artificial Flavoring

The flavour in our products comes entirely from the quality of the source milk, the breed, and the process. No artificial enhancement of any kind.

💉
No Synthetic Hormones

Our animals are never injected with rBST or any synthetic growth hormones to artificially boost milk yield. Our volumes reflect natural production.

🔬
Antibiotic Discipline

When veterinary treatment requires antibiotics, that animal's milk is kept out of our supply for the mandatory withdrawal period. No exceptions.

🌡️
Chilled Within 30 Minutes

Every collection is chilled to below 4°C within 30 minutes of milking. Cold chain integrity from farm to your door — not approximated, maintained.

📋
Batch Records Available

Every product batch has a source record. Ask us about any product you've received — we can trace it. This accountability is intentional.
